{"metadata":{"description":"Upload arbitrary local files from the DeepSeek Harness Web composer and manage them in Settings.","id":"gh:1333827740","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-file-uploads","slug":"l541402398/dsh-file-uploads","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","file-upload","web-ui"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Upload arbitrary local files from the DeepSeek Harness Web composer and manage them in Settings."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-file-uploads"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Upload arbitrary local files from the DeepSeek Harness Web composer, attach their container paths to"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" prompts, and manage stored uploads from Settings."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Adds a **Files** button beside the existing composer controls.
- Accepts multiple arbitrary local "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"files, not only images.
- Shows pending files as image-like cards above the composer.
- Keeps the te"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"xt editor clean: no visible path or generated description is inserted into the draft.
- Serializes e"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ach hidden file reference into a model-readable absolute path only when the message is submitted.
- "},{"id":"p6s5","text":"Clears pending cards after submission and restores them when submission fails.
- Stores every upload"},{"id":"p6s6","text":" in one fixed directory, `$DSH_HOME/uploads` by default.
- Lists uploaded files in **Settings → Uplo"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"aded files**, with download and delete actions.
- Prevents overwrites by publishing duplicates as `n"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"ame (1).ext`, `name (2).ext`, and so on.
- Enforces per-file and total-directory quotas."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6`
- Web profile
- Node.js 22 or newer"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Harness currently transports native attachments as raster images only. This plugin intentionally use"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"s the arbitrary-file path supported by the agent environment: it stores the file inside the Harness "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"host/container and adds that path to the submitted text through the built-in input-reference seriali"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"/container and adds that path to the submitted text through the built-in input-reference serializer."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Install the tagged GitHub release into the Web profile:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Restart the running Web profile after installation, then refresh the browser page."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"To install the latest development branch instead:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"To remove it:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Use"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"1. Open a conversation in the Harness Web GUI.
2. Select **Files** in the composer toolbar.
3. Choos"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"e one or more local files.
4. Review or remove the pending cards above the composer.
5. Add any norm"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"al prompt text you want, or leave the editor empty.
6. Submit the message. The model receives a line"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" text you want, or leave the editor empty.
6. Submit the message. The model receives a line such as:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The generated line is never shown in the editor before submission. The stored path refers to the fil"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"esystem visible to the Harness host; in a Docker deployment, this is the path inside the container."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Settings"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The plugin adds an **Uploaded files** section to Settings. It displays:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- the fixed storage directory;
- per-file and total-directory limits;
- current storage usage;
- fil"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"e name, size, modification time, and absolute path;
- download and delete actions."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Files persist until they are deleted manually."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The plugin works without configuration. These environment variables override its defaults:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---:|---|
| `DSH_UPLOAD_DIR` | `$DSH_HOME/uploads` | Absolute "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"upload directory. |
| `DSH_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES` | `104857600` | Maximum bytes per file (100 MiB). |
| `"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"DSH_UPLOAD_TOTAL_MAX_BYTES` | `1073741824` | Maximum total bytes in the directory (1 GiB). |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Example Docker Compose fragment:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Security model"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- List, upload, download, and delete routes use the same loopback/trusted-host and Origin checks as "},{"id":"p32s2","text":"the built-in Harness Web API.
- Cross-site browser requests are rejected.
- File names are normalize"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"d and stripped of path components and control characters.
- Downloads and deletions accept only regu"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"lar files in the configured directory and do not follow symbolic links.
- Uploads are written to pri"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"vate temporary files, synced, and atomically published without overwriting existing files.
- Interru"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"pted `.upload-*` temporary files are removed when the plugin starts.
- Unexpected server errors are "},{"id":"p32s7","text":"logged without returning internal paths to the browser."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"This trust fence is not a user-account authentication system. If the Harness Web GUI is exposed to o"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"ther users or the public Internet, protect the whole deployment with an authenticated reverse proxy "},{"id":"p33s3","text":"and configure Harness trusted hosts correctly."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Run the checks:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"The package is a persistent dual-face Cordis bundle:"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"- `index.js` — Host HTTP routes, storage, quotas, and trust checks.
- `client.js` — composer button,"},{"id":"p38s2","text":" pending-file rail, hidden reference codec, and Settings UI.
- `cordis.patch.yml` — installable `dsh"},{"id":"p38s3","text":".bundle` composition row.
- `test/upload-manager.test.js` — Host storage and security regression tes"},{"id":"p38s4","text":"ndle` composition row.
- `test/upload-manager.test.js` — Host storage and security regression tests."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"See CONTRIBUTING.md for local-link development instructions."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
